reason: The hypothesis makes multiple specific claims about PVD process capability, coating architecture performance, and durability under aggressive conditions, but cites no prior evidence whatsoever to support any of these key premises.
premises: PVD can deposit a ~100 μm multilayer ceramic coating with an alumina bond layer and YSZ top layer on Ni superalloys
The alumina bond layer reduces thermal mismatch and improves adhesion
The YSZ top layer acts as an effective oxygen and corrosive species barrier at up to 1000°C
The multilayer ceramic coating significantly improves oxidation resistance and mechanical performance vs. uncoated superalloy under cyclic high-temperature conditions
The coating remains effective under thermal cycling up to 1000°C without premature delamination or failure
